Package edu.uoc.pac2

Class MuseumArtifact

java.lang.Object
edu.uoc.pac2.MuseumArtifact
public class MuseumArtifact extends Object
MuseumArtifact represents an artefact held by a museum. The museum must store its basic details, monitor its condition and determine whether it can be made available for temporary loans requested by other institutions.
